title: Afterlight: Racing Festival
shortDescription: Race 20 original circuits, build your garage and chase the Afterlight Festival.
fullDescription:
Your father's Solstice. A shuttered garage. One last road to the summit.

Join Mika and a cast of district champions in Afterlight: Racing Festival, an offline arcade racing adventure. Rebuild your garage's reputation from the Riviera to Night City, the Badlands and the Alpine summit.

TWENTY ORIGINAL CIRCUITS
Explore five distinct routes in each of four districts. Coastal resorts, sailing marinas, neon waterfronts, sandstone arches, mountain viaducts and snowbound summit stations give every route its own setting.

EIGHTY CAMPAIGN EVENTS
Compete in Circuit races, Time attack and Drift runs, plus rotating Elimination, Knockdown and Duel events. Earn stars to unlock the next district.

TWELVE FICTIONAL CARS
Earn race credits, collect cars and tune each through four upgrade stages. Find your balance of top speed, acceleration and handling. All vehicles and upgrades are earned by playing.

STUNTS, RIVALS AND NITRO
Accelerate automatically and steer with touch controls or optional tilt steering. Drift through corners, build combos, hit rivals under nitro for takedowns and launch from ramps for jumps and barrel rolls. Double-tap nitro with half a tank for a shockwave boost.

A STORY TO RECOVER
Collect memory chips to recharge nitro and recover four pages of your father's notebook. Meet Luca, Nova, Rafa and Iris, and discover the road your father never finished.

DAILY DRIFT CHALLENGE
Return for a rotating daily drift trial. The first starred run each day awards 350 bonus race credits. Track personal records, driver experience and milestones.

BUILT FOR OFFLINE PLAY
All environments, music, story and gameplay are installed with the game. No account, advertising, in-app purchases, analytics or tracking. Garage progress, race records and settings stay on your device.

Landscape gameplay for phones and tablets. Original circuits, fictional cars, licensed 3D artwork, a Suno-composed soundtrack and a real-time engine synthesizer. Created by Oana Rinaldi.
